title: Karate: the greats overview
d: The greatest Karate players, ranked by titles, records, and influence.
definition: The greatest Karate players, ranked by titles, records, and influence.
description: The pantheon of Karate is argued in every bar and barbershop, but the names in this database appear on every serious list: champions who won the biggest prizes, record-setters whose numbers still stand, and pioneers who changed how Karate is played.
